job.title: Structural Engineer
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Vivid Recruitment is partnering with a highly respected, global engineering consultancy with a strong national presence. Known for their technical excellence and client-first approach, they’ve been delivering structural and civil solutions across commercial, residential, education, and infrastructure sectors for decades.

Their Sydney office is expanding, and they’re looking for a talented Structural Engineer with 2–5 years’ experience to join their team and play a key role in the delivery of a diverse pipeline of projects.

THE ROLE

In this role, you’ll apply sound engineering principles to deliver practical, buildable, and cost-effective solutions. Working alongside senior engineers and drafters, you’ll contribute to all aspects of project delivery — from concept to construction documentation — while liaising with clients, consultants, and project stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop and deliver structural designs, documentation, specifications, and reports
  • Solve complex engineering challenges using a mix of first-principles thinking and modern tools
  • Liaise with drafters to ensure the delivery of high-quality structural documentation
  • Coordinate and communicate with architects, builders, and services consultants
  • Use design software including ETABS, SpaceGass, RAM, and RAPT
  • Ensure compliance with relevant codes, quality systems, and WHS practices
  • Assist in preparing fee proposals and project bids
  • Provide support to senior engineers while steadily building your own autonomy
ABOUT YOU

You’re a motivated and detail-driven engineer ready to step up on larger and more complex projects within a collaborative and dynamic team.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil/Structural Engineering
  • Ideally 2–5 years’ experience in a local consultancy
  • Proficiency in ETABS, SpaceGass, RAM, and RAPT
  • Member of Engineers Australia (or working towards CPEng)
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience working closely with drafters and coordinating across disciplines
  • Familiarity with local codes and Australian standards
THE PERKS
  • Strong pipeline of exciting NSW-based projects
  • Work in a global consultancy with a growing local footprint
  • Supportive, technically sharp team culture
  • Opportunities for career progression and pathway to CPEng
  • Competitive salary + training and development
  • Flexible work options
HOW TO APPLY
       
If this sounds like you, please get in touch with Nick Koop today on 0426 180 254 or nick@vividrecruitment.com.au. 
       
OTHER OPPORTUNITIES
        
Nick is looking for talented mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and fire protection engineers. If you know anyone who is looking for a role in this space, please reach out to Nick anytime!

job.title: Senior Fire Protection Engineer
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Vivid Recruitment is partnering with a national consultancy to find a Senior Fire Protection Engineer in Brisbane. This multi-disciplinary firm takes a cutting-edge approach to building services design and is dedicated to delivering excellence in both technical solutions and client service. From concept to completion, they are passionate about developing sustainable building services solutions, with a diverse portfolio spanning commercial, residential, healthcare, and education sectors.

THE ROLE

You will be responsible for the following:
  • Lead and oversee fire protection engineering projects.
  • Conduct site assessments, evaluate risks, and analyse codes to identify fire hazards and develop effective mitigation strategies.
  • Collaborate with contractors, architects, designers, and regulatory bodies to integrate fire safety measures into building designs and construction plans.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers.
  • Serve as the primary client contact, providing updates, addressing queries, and delivering outstanding customer service.
ABOUT YOU

You will have the following skills:
  • At least 5-9 years local experience
  • Permanent work rights in Australia
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, or related field. Master's degree preferred
  • Proficiency in fire protection system design software
  • Can work autonomously with strong leadership, communication & collaboration skills
  • Can work on projects throughout the lifecycle
THE PERKS

This opportunity is a good one because:
  • $110,000 - $150,000 per year + super, depending on experience
  • Flexible with WFH options
  • Paid Parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • Training

job.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
job.description:
Vivid Recruitment is partnering with a well-established, multi-discipline consultancy that’s known for its grounded, no-fuss approach to engineering. With offices across Australia and a strong track record in delivering practical, buildable designs, they’ve built a reputation for quality work and long-term client relationships across sectors like education, health, commercial, retail, and mixed-use.

Right now, they’re looking to bring on a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join their Sydney office—someone confident in HVAC design who can take ownership of projects, liaise with clients, and collaborate across disciplines. It’s an on-site role with solid drafting support and a strong pipeline of projects.

What You'll Be Doing:
  • Deliver mechanical (HVAC) designs for a range of building projects—Olympic, health, education, commercial, etc.
  • Coordinate with clients, architects, and internal disciplines to ensure cohesive, high-quality outcomes
  • Run projects independently, but also contribute as part of a close-knit mechanical team
  • Attend site visits, support construction teams, and respond to RFIs where needed
  • Support and mentor junior engineers and drafters
What They’re Looking For:
  • 5+ years’ experience in mechanical building services design (consultancy background)
  • Solid understanding of Australian Standards, NCC, and industry best practice
  • Comfortable running jobs and fronting client conversations when needed
  • Proficiency in mechanical design software and documentation processes
  • Must be Sydney-based or willing to relocate; this is not a remote role
Why Consider This?
  • Strong, steady workflow with a grounded and loyal client base
  • You’ll be trusted to get on with it—no micromanagement
  • Stable consultancy with long-term staff and approachable leadership
  • Opportunity to step into more responsibility over time, or simply do great project work in a supportive environment
  • Sponsorship is on offer
If you’re a mechanical engineer who enjoys delivering clean, well-coordinated projects—and want to work with a team that values doing the job well without the ego—I’d love to chat.

job.title: Senior Civil Engineer
job.description:
OUR CLIENT

Vivid Recruitment is proud to partner with a well-established Australian-owned engineering consultancy with offices both nationally and internationally. With a decades-long reputation for excellence, this firm partners closely with clients to deliver innovative, practical, and high-impact civil and structural design solutions.

As a result of recent project wins, they’re growing their civil team and now seeking an experienced Senior Civil Engineer to join the Brisbane office.

THE ROLE

This role will see you working across a diverse range of public and private sector projects including streetscapes, recreational parks and facilities, education, and transport infrastructure.

As a Senior Civil Engineer, you’ll take ownership of design and project delivery while mentoring junior engineers and collaborating with key stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Prepare concept and detailed civil designs that meet brief, budget, and buildability requirements
  • Deliver accurate, error-free designs and reports with a focus on practical outcomes
  • Manage civil documentation across all phases – from concept to construction
  • Review and approve work from junior and intermediate engineers
  • Lead and coordinate with clients, consultants, and multi-disciplinary teams
  • Understand local authority standards, approvals processes, and design impacts
  • Mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to a collaborative team culture
  • Support project bids, proposals, and submissions when required
ABOUT YOU

To be successful in this role, you’ll bring:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering (or equivalent)
  • Minimum 7 years’ experience in civil engineering within a local Australian consultancy
  • Strong technical design skills using Civil 3D
  • Demonstrated ability to manage projects from design through delivery
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Experience across urban development, roads, drainage, and public infrastructure
  • Ability to work independently and mentor junior staff effectively
  • Proactive and adaptable mindset – you thrive in a dynamic team
THE PERKS
  • Competitive salary with flexibility based on experience
  • Collaborative, close-knit civil team within a well-respected national firm
  • Work on diverse and iconic infrastructure projects
  • Career development opportunities with national and international exposure
  • Supportive culture with a focus on quality, innovation, and balance
  • Clear leadership pathways and ongoing technical development
